title: A Summer for the Garden Again
author: Sable Thackeray
blurb: Lior Vane, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
